# ataila_projects (Data Source)

The projects on the platform, optionally filtered, in id order: summaries without settings or outputs (read one with the `ataila_project` data source for those). The provider reads every page of the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every active project of one customer.
data "ataila_projects" "active" {
  customer_id = ataila_customer.example.id
  status      = "active"
}

output "active_projects" {
  value = [for p in data.ataila_projects.active.projects : p.short_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Only the projects of this customer.
- `short_name` (String) Only the project with this short name.
- `status` (String) Only the projects with this status: `planned`, `provisioning`, `active`, `paused` or `retired`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Only the projects of this tenant.

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) The projects, in id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created: RFC 3339 in UTC, compared as an instant.
- `customer_id` (String) Id of the customer of the owning tenant (null for a tenant without a customer, which only the platform's own projects have).
- `deployment_backend` (String) `k8s` or `vm`.
- `gitlab_repo_slug` (String) Application repository name.
- `id` (String) Project id, assigned by the platform.
- `is_self` (Boolean) One of the platform's own projects: readable, never writable through the API.
- `long_name` (String) Display name.
- `network_only` (Boolean) A network zone only.
- `primary_domain` (String) Primary domain.
- `project_index` (Number) The project's index, 1-99.
- `short_name` (String) Short name.
- `status` (String) `planned` until provisioning starts, then `provisioning`, `active` once every stage is done, `paused`, or `retired`. Read-only.
- `tenant_id` (String) Id of the owning tenant.
